title: rotationGWAS: Rotation for Two-Stage Genome-Wide Association Analysis
description: An R package for the second stage of a two-stage genome-wide association analysis of adjusted means from an unbalanced field trial. The full first-stage variance-covariance matrix of the means is carried into the second stage by the rotation of Piepho et al. (2012): the adjusted means and every term of the second-stage model are pre-multiplied by the same matrix, after which the estimation errors are independent with unit variance and the second stage is an ordinary mixed-model GWAS. The package reports the loss of precision under inverse-variance weighting and under the unweighted analysis for every marker before the scan, runs the P3D genome scan, tests the residual variance of the rotated model against one, extends the model by an effect independent across accessions, and refits markers close to the threshold with the residual variance fixed at one. It accompanies the manuscript 'Exact weighting in two-stage genome-wide association analysis: when does it matter?' by Habib and Piepho (2026).
